title: 最危险的漏洞不在外面：CEO说内部可能就是缺口，生产系统还怎么守？
speaker: Tan Su Shan

segments.en: I guess before we move to the macro final question on AI and cybersecurity given the by Nance hack over the weekend.
segments.zh: 我想在进入宏观最后关于AI和网络安全的问题之前，鉴于周末Nance遭黑客攻击。

segments.en: What's your assessment of the nature of the threat the new threat.
segments.zh: 你对这种新威胁的性质有何评估？

segments.en: I think if you're always connected to the internet and you have hot wallets and you don't have mitigants then you know back to good old basic cyber hygiene.
segments.zh: 我认为如果你一直联网，有热钱包，又没有缓解措施，那就得回到基本的网络安全卫生。

segments.en: My learning is cyber hygiene trumps everything and treat inside as the outside that means trust nothing.
segments.zh: 我的经验是网络安全卫生高于一切，把内部当作外部，即不信任任何东西。

segments.en: It could be that the vulnerability sitting right inside your organization.
segments.zh: 漏洞可能就在你组织内部。

segments.en: Number one number two is access right whether it's your laptop your servers whenever make sure you really protect access to production.
segments.zh: 第一第二是访问权限，无论是笔记本电脑还是服务器，都要确保真正保护生产环境的访问。

segments.en: We've learned that over the years do not let your production systems be open to everyone and anyone.
segments.zh: 多年来我们学到，不要让生产系统对所有人开放。

segments.en: Anyone touching production make sure you have a strong system of security make sure every code every change management they're doing has strong gates so that you're protecting your production.
segments.zh: 任何接触生产环境的人，都要有强大的安全体系，确保每个代码、每次变更管理都有强力的关卡，从而保护生产环境。
